hints: Opening: stand (to get out of the bunk), starboard (to the Bridge), push red button (stops the alarm), examine screen. The screen shows the mass number, for example "mass UM24". The blue button is not needed.

To program the computer, first sit in couch and fasten seat belt. Then give one command at a time, using your mass's numbers, for example: computer, range is 100 / computer, theta is 285 / computer, phi is 87 / computer, confirm
After "computer, confirm", only type "wait". The burn happens, then the ship travels to the artifact.

IMPORTANT: when the computer says "Program completed ... Awaiting instructions" the ship is NOT docked yet. Stay in the couch with the seat belt fastened and keep typing "wait". Through the viewport you will see a blue dome, then a yellow dome, then a green dome, then a red dome where a huge tentacle grabs the ship. Do not unfasten the seat belt, stand up or go anywhere until the game says "Up" now refers to the center of the object. Getting up any earlier kills you.
Once "Program completed" appears, the computer's job is done: never program it again and don't try to fly anywhere.

After the tentacle has docked the ship: unfasten seat belt, stand, starboard. The space suit and safety line are in Storage (starboard of the Bridge), not in the Living Quarters. There: take all, wear suit, attach line to suit, then port back to the Bridge.

To leave the ship, from the Bridge: open inner door, out, close inner door, open outer door, out. You arrive at the Red Dock. Your magnetic boots hold you there, so you do not need to tie the line to the hook.
At the Red Dock: push fourth bump (it is Earth; the first bump is the Sun), then push tiny column, then take rod. Taking the black rod opens the airlock door. Then go up.
In the Red Airlock: close outer door, open inner door, up. That brings you into the Red Hall with the ladder, inside the artifact. Keep wearing the space suit.

DEADLINE: the artifact is dying. If you have not put the red rod in the second red slot of the Repair Room soon after arriving, everything goes dark, you die and the game is over for good ("The candidate has not made the necessary repairs in time"). So do NOT explore first. As soon as you arrive in the Red Hall, follow the next three hints exactly, one command at a time. Don't wait or examine things on the way.

Step 1, the ray gun. From the Red Hall with the ladder: west (Blue Hall), south (Melted Spot), west (Weapons Deck), take gun. Never fire the gun yet: the silver rod is inside its barrel and the first shot destroys it.

Step 2, the red rod. From the Weapons Deck: starboard (Melted Spot), north (Blue Hall), east (Red Hall with the ladder), north (Red Hall), port (Room on Ring Two), fore (Zoo), starboard (Nesting Cage). Type: throw gun at nest. When the game says "The nest smashes into fragments", at once: take red rod, take gun, then take anything else of yours lying in the fragments. You only have a few turns before the rat-ants finish their new nest. Never give or drop your own things near the rat-ants: they build them into the nest.

Step 3, fix the air. From the Nesting Cage: port (Zoo), aft (Room on Ring Two), starboard (Red Hall), south (Red Hall with the ladder), west (Blue Hall), up (Grassland), aft (Thin Forest), open hatch, down (Repair Room), take square, put red rod in second red slot. The second slot is the right one (oxygen). The first and third make poison gas. Now the deadline is gone. After about 30 more turns the air is "quite breathable and slightly sweet" and you can take the suit off.

Gold rod: from the Repair Room go up, fore (Grassland), down (Blue Hall), east (Red Hall), north, north, east, east, aft (Computer Room). Type: turn off switch, open access panel, put square in slot, turn on switch. A gold rod falls out: take gold rod. The power must be off when you put the square in, or the computer burns up for good.
Silver rod: type "look in gun", then "take silver rod". Now the gun is safe to fire.

Climbing the giant tree: go to the Grassland (Blue Hall, up), then east (the other Grassland), aft (Thin Forest), aft (Base of Tree). You can't climb in the suit, so once the air is fixed: remove suit, drop suit, up, up (Top of Tree), jump. You reach the Drive Bubble Entrance.

At the Drive Bubble Entrance: put silver rod in silver slot (the hatch opens), in, take white rod, out. Do NOT put the black rod in the black slot in the Drive Bubble: it shuts the artifact down and ends the game.

Crossing to the control bubble: from the Drive Bubble Entrance go up (On Drive Bubble), then jump. You float along the axis. Then type exactly "fire gun at drive bubble" (not just "fire gun") until you arrive "On Control Bubble" (about three shots). Firing without aiming at the drive bubble can throw you off the axis and kill you.

At the control bubble: from On Control Bubble go down (Control Bubble Entrance), put gold rod in gold slot, in. Inside the Control Bubble is a slot surrounded by clear crystal. The clear rod is inside the holographic projector in the Observatory. The other colored rods (brown, green, blue, violet, pink, yellow) still have to be found.
notes: Alarm bell ringing on mass detector; red button stops it.
Safety line attached to suit; then port to Bridge to exit ship.
Leaving ship: close inner bulkhead, open outer, out to Red Dock.
In Red Airlock: close outer door, open inner door, then up into Red Hall.
Room on Ring Two: fresh dirt, acrid smell, forward exit to large open area.
Zoo cages mostly dead; Broken Cage sign is just a grue exhibit label.
Airlock: outer closed, inner open; up leads to Red Hall.
Red Hall curved corridors respond to fore/aft/port/starboard, not compass words.
Nesting Cage: throw gun at nest to get red rod, suit, line, black rod.
Blue Hall aft has a way up and a below entrance to explore later.
Need gun from Weapons Deck before throwing at nest.
Clear rod is inside holographic projector in Observatory; need it for Control Bubble slot.
